description: Gradle (Android, Spring Boot, Ktor, Kotlin Multiplatform): CI with setup-java, setup-gradle, check and assemble
notes: check runs tests and every verification plugin the build applies; add Spotless (format) and detekt or Checkstyle (lint), or Android lint applies. Set --java to the toolchain the build declares. Commit the Gradle wrapper (gradlew, gradle/wrapper).
